work.text: A mannerism, apparently introduced by Riza, was to incline the … standing figures forwards as if they were suddenly arrested in a forward movement.

work.lead: Gray, on a mannerism of Riza’s figures:

work.text: This trait is most obvious in the more complex manuscript illustrations by him such as a double-page country picnic of a young lord, dated 1612, in the Hermitage, particularly rich with gold sky and gold margin decoration into which the miniatures extend.
